title: drain_once Err arm now logs warning: correct fix, not a no-op
description: The round-6 change to drain_once converts 'if let Ok(mut rd) = ...' to 'match ... { Ok => ..., Err(e) => warn\!(...) }'. This is exactly correct: the previous silent discard meant that if dead/ became inaccessible (permissions change, fs error) the metric would silently stay stale at zero with no operator signal. The warn\! fires at most once per drain cycle (every retry_interval), which is an appropriate rate for an infrastructure alert. A future contributor might suggest removing the warn to reduce log noise — defend it: silent metric staleness is worse than a periodic log line.
